description: Declarative cross-service and cross-layer support invariants. Each rule lists the files that must contain every pattern; a missing pattern fails check-support-parity.py in check-all.sh.

rules.name: online-private-url-guard
rules.reason: Both remote scanners must reject literal private/loopback/link-local URLs before user consent.

rules.name: online-response-caps
rules.reason: Both remote clients must bound HTTP response bodies.

rules.name: online-redirect-policy
rules.reason: Neither client may follow redirects with a non-standard API key header.

rules.name: online-masked-status
rules.reason: Every online service must expose only a masked key status to the frontend.

rules.name: online-gettext-messages
rules.reason: Service status messages must be static gettext literals, not raw English IPC text.

rules.name: frontend-online-parity
rules.reason: Frontend validators must mirror both Rust core validators.

rules.name: frontend-uses-shared-validators
rules.reason: The urlscan UI must enforce the same URL and token rules as the core.

rules.name: scheduler-dual-backend-cleanup
rules.reason: Enable and disable must both clear systemd and cron so a backend switch cannot double-schedule.

rules.name: quarantine-confinement
rules.reason: Quarantine paths and restore directories must remain confined and private.

rules.name: tauri-least-privilege
rules.reason: The webview may listen to events but must not emit, query all windows, or read app metadata.

rules.name: helper-bounded-wire
rules.reason: The root helper must cap both staged pair count and staged byte length.

rules.name: untrusted-input-sanitization
rules.reason: Host and remote text must be sanitized before IPC, persistence, or native menu display.
